title: Single File Repo
description: Goal for Single File Repo. "Single file" means one file per semantic/domain component — a 🦀️component.rs, a topic module — not one file per crate, and not collapsing an intentionally-split module tree back into a single lib.rs. --- SCOPE NOTE (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/SINGLE-FILE-REPO-GOAL-RESCOPE-AND-HAZARD-DOCUMENTATION, see also master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE): files under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/**/🗿️artifacts, 🎛️apps, 🎭️modes, 🪟️windows, 🍱️panes, 🪀️widgets, 🪛️utilities, 🎬️actions, 🎚️options, 📌️panels, 🎮️commands, 🛠️tools taxonomy directories, and consolidated-framework-crate module files (🦀️<name>.rs wired via #[path] from a crate-root 📦️lib.rs), are OUT OF SCOPE for single-file consolidation and MUST NOT be inlined back into their parent lib.rs or module file. These are already "single file" at the correct grain (one file per component); merging them regresses the taxonomy, not simplifies it. --- SCOPE NOTE 2 (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE): the same exclusion extends to every language, not just Rust. Any file matching a `🔣️taxonomy.json` `taxonomyLeafFilenames` value (🦀️component.rs, 🟦️component.tsx, 🐍️component.py, 🔷️component.cs) under a `🧱️elements/<Element>/` co-location directory, its wiring-only entry file (`📦️lib.rs` #[path] tree or `📦️index.tsx` re-export barrel) under `<owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/🎯️targets/<target>/` or `<owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/`, its co-located `🧪️story.tsx`, and target-dir `🦀️<name>.rs` module files under `🧰️framework/**/📦️packages/**`, are OUT OF SCOPE and MUST NOT be inlined back into their entry barrel/lib.rs — same reasoning as Scope Note 1, applied to the TypeScript-side split (e.g. `🖱️ui`'s per-element `🟦️component.tsx` files extracted from the former monolithic `📦️index.tsx`). This does not sanction leaving a split half-finished: the owning ticket's own agent re-inlining ITS OWN failed/aborted extraction (to keep the tree compile-green) remains allowed — only a THIRD PARTY consolidation pass merging an already-completed split is forbidden. This scope note does not close or supersede the goal — it clarifies what "single file" is measured against.
prompt: Instructions for Single File Repo. "Single file" for this repo is a per-semantic-component target, not a per-crate or per-plugin target: fold accidental/incidental file splits (leftover scratch files, near-duplicate helpers, historical one-off scripts) into their single natural home, but never merge intentionally-split #[path] module trees. --- EXCLUSIONS (amended 2026-08-05): before inlining any #[path]-attributed .rs file into a parent lib.rs or component file, check whether it sits under a ✏️s/🔌️plugins/<plugin>/ taxonomy directory (🗿️artifacts/🔺️diff, 🗣️dsl, 🎒️pack, 🔧️op, 📡️spr, ⚙️engine; 🎛️apps/.../🎭️modes/.../🪟️windows/.../🍱️panes|🪀️widgets|🪛️utilities|🎬️actions|🎚️options; 📌️panels; 🎮️commands; 🛠️tools) or is a consolidated-framework-crate module file. If so, STOP — do not inline, do not delete the split file. --- EXCLUSIONS 2 (amended 2026-08-05, ticket 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE): before inlining ANY file — Rust or otherwise — into a parent entry file, also check whether it sits under a `🧱️elements/<Element>/` co-location directory anywhere under `🧰️framework/**` (e.g. `🖱️ui/🧱️elements/Select/🟦️component.tsx`, `…/🧊️component.rs`), or is a `📦️index.tsx` re-export barrel / `📦️lib.rs` #[path] wiring file under a `📦️packages/<lang>/🎯️targets/<target>/` or `📦️packages/<lang>/` package dir. If so, STOP — do not inline, do not delete the split file, regardless of language. The historical playbook in .cursor/plans/single_file_consolidation_bdb40556.plan.md is NOT applicable to any of these paths; running it there has already caused two prior regressions of an unrelated crate-consolidation restructure. Full context and the taxonomy validator that enforces this at `verify gate`: master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md, section "Single-File-Repo hazard ruling", and 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md for the TS-side extension.
